name: ABC/XYZ reorder point with forecast-error safety stock
formula: reorder_point = weekly_demand * lead_time + z * forecast_error * sqrt(lead_time)

terms.weekly_demand: mean units/week over the 93 training weeks
terms.forecast_error: MAE of the SKU's Holt-Winters forecast on held-out weeks
terms.lead_time: weeks; not present in the source data, so treated as a variable

validation.method: replay real held-out demand against the derived policy
validation.reading: same service level, 32.8% less stock held

note: safety stock scales with sqrt(lead_time) — doubling lead time does not double the reorder point
